description:
Activate Pashalik Mons by paying {3}{R} and sacrificing a Goblin.
The Goblin dies, triggering Pashalik Mons, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Pashalik Mons ability from step 1, creating two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
The Goblins enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes twice, adding {C}{C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
